__broaden__.αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’) · also fem. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the others’ (αἱ ἄλλαι ’the other ships’)
__broaden__.αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
__broaden__.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’
__broaden__.βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ‘good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός) · also fem. acc. sg., direct object: ’shout’ (τεῦχε βοήν ’was raising a shout’)
__broaden__.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’)
__broaden__.δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk, timber; also spear; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: δόρυ χάλκεον ... εἰρυσάμην ’I drew out the bronze spear’
__broaden__.ἐκβαίνοντα: ἐκβαίνω — step out, disembark; pres. part. acc. sg. masc., agreeing with an understood ’me’ (μ’ ἐκβαίνοντα) · also agreeing with a stated pronoun: τὸν … ἐκβαίνοντα ’him as he came out’
__broaden__.ἐοικότες: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting, resemble; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’fitting’ (μῦθοι ἐοικότες ’fitting words’) · also + dat., ’like, resembling’ (ἄνδρεσσιν ἐοικότες ’like men’)
__broaden__.ἴδοιμι: ὁράω — see; aor. 2 opt. 1 sg. (from εἶδον), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I might see’ · also after εἴ πως, of an aim in view: ’(to see) if somehow I might see’
__broaden__.ἰφθίμῃ: Ἰφθίμη — Iphthime, Penelope’s sister, wife of Eumelus; fem. dat. sg. · also ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; adj., fem. dat. sg. form, qualifying θυγατέρ’
__broaden__.πολυβενθέος: πολυβενθής — very deep, many-fathomed (πολύς + βένθος); adj., fem. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg., with λιμένος (two-ending adj.)
__broaden__.πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid. πυθέσθαι, epexegetic: ’to hear of’ (κλέος ... πυθέσθαι ’fame ... to hear of’) · also aor. inf. mid., of purpose after a verb of sending: ’to inquire’ (προέμεν πυθέσθαι ’to send forth to inquire’)
__broaden__.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
__broaden__.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’)
__broaden__.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’)
__broaden__.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’)
__broaden__.χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ as subject
__broaden__.ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they threw down’ · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I threw down’
__broaden__.θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg. · also life, the breath of life
